sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: OpenID Connect：ID Token 的驗證鏈
related.titleEn: OpenID Connect: the ID Token validation chain
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：所有邊界符合floor規則，已使用碼拒絕；教學時間值未被誤標為實際認證安全強度。 交付區間圖、邊界測試表與不含秘密的驗證結果。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All boundaries obey floor semantics and consumed codes are rejected; teaching timestamps are not mislabeled as authentication strength. Deliver an interval diagram, boundary tests and verification results containing no secrets.
related.difference: 用假的 JWT 欄位表排列 iss、aud、azp、exp、iat、nonce 與簽章金鑰選擇；建立驗證順序與每種失敗的可觀測理由。
related.differenceEn: Order issuer, audience, authorized party, expiry, issued-at, nonce and signing-key checks in a fake JWT field table; document each failure reason.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: T=floor((t−T0)/X)；步數邊界是半開區間，放寬視窗增加可接受候選，並不消除線上速率限制與重播控制需求。 T0=0、X=30秒、t=95秒，整數時間不含網路延遲。 floor(95/30)=3；t改125秒時floor(125/30)=4。另需檢查t=119與120分屬步數3與4。
驗證須固定可信 issuer 與允許演算法，再核對 audience、時效及流程要求；解碼 JSON 不等於驗證簽章。 教學 token 的exp=1200秒，驗證時刻1010秒，允許時鐘偏移30秒；本題只計時效上限餘裕。 exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220秒；偏移容忍改0後為190秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: T=floor((t−T0)/X); intervals are half-open, and widening the window increases candidates without removing rate-limit or replay-control requirements. T0=0, X=30 seconds and t=95 seconds, using integer timestamps with no network delay. floor(95/30)=3; at t=125, floor(125/30)=4. Also verify that t=119 and 120 belong to steps 3 and 4.

Pin trusted issuer and allowed algorithms, then validate audience, time and flow-specific claims; decoding JSON does not verify a signature. A teaching token expires at 1200 seconds, verification occurs at 1010, and permitted clock skew is 30 seconds; calculate only the expiry upper-bound margin. exp+skew−now=1200+30−1010=220 seconds; with zero skew allowance, margin is 190 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ACME：憑證續期與故障預算
related.titleEn: ACME: certificate renewal and failure budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：所有邊界符合floor規則，已使用碼拒絕；教學時間值未被誤標為實際認證安全強度。 交付區間圖、邊界測試表與不含秘密的驗證結果。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All boundaries obey floor semantics and consumed codes are rejected; teaching timestamps are not mislabeled as authentication strength. Deliver an interval diagram, boundary tests and verification results containing no secrets.
related.difference: 以自有測試域名的紙面訂單追蹤account、order、authorization、challenge與憑證；分開標示挑戰成功、簽發成功及服務實際載入。
related.differenceEn: Trace account, order, authorization, challenge and certificate in a paper workflow for an owned test domain; separate challenge success, issuance and actual service loading.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: T=floor((t−T0)/X)；步數邊界是半開區間，放寬視窗增加可接受候選，並不消除線上速率限制與重播控制需求。 T0=0、X=30秒、t=95秒，整數時間不含網路延遲。 floor(95/30)=3；t改125秒時floor(125/30)=4。另需檢查t=119與120分屬步數3與4。
續期餘裕=到期日−開始續期日；可重試預算需另扣維護或故障時間，成功下載憑證不表示所有服務都已更新。 教學憑證在第30日到期，原定第20日開始續期；這些日期是示例而非公開CA有效期規則。 30−20=10日餘裕；若延至第25日開始則只剩5日。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: T=floor((t−T0)/X); intervals are half-open, and widening the window increases candidates without removing rate-limit or replay-control requirements. T0=0, X=30 seconds and t=95 seconds, using integer timestamps with no network delay. floor(95/30)=3; at t=125, floor(125/30)=4. Also verify that t=119 and 120 belong to steps 3 and 4.

Renewal margin is expiry day minus renewal-start day; maintenance and outages consume it, and a downloaded certificate does not prove every service updated. A teaching certificate expires on day 30 and renewal starts on day 20; these are invented dates, not public-CA validity rules. 30−20=10 days of margin; delaying start to day 25 leaves 5 days.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

courses.overview: 比較相鄰案例與另一組案例的模型、可量測結果及可轉移的驗證方法。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighboring and cross-group cases by model, measurable outcome, and transferable verification method.
